title: Harden DAO file persistence against concurrent processes and hostile files
description: P1 security/robustness: TwoSlotFilePersistence uses only an instance-local threading.Lock, predictable shared *.tmp names, path.exists()/open() following symlinks, inherited directory/file modes, and unbounded f.read(). Two instances/processes can choose the same generation/slot and race temp replacement, losing an acknowledged replay floor or TX sequence; a local attacker can redirect/clobber files, read signed DAO state, or cause memory exhaustion with an oversized slot. Use an owned private directory, no-follow/regular-file validation, restrictive modes, an inter-process lock/CAS, unique safe staging, and a strict payload/file-size ceiling; test two instances plus symlink/oversize cases.
